content.myth: “My IPMAT Indore score works for IIM Rohtak too.”
content.detail:
{b:IPMAT Indore:} IIM Indore, Ranchi, Sirmaur, Amritsar, Sambalpur, Shillong, IIFT Kakinada
{b:JIPMAT:} IIM Jammu, IIM Bodh Gaya
{b:IPMAT Rohtak:} IIM Rohtak

caption:
Myth: one IPMAT score works everywhere.
Fact: each exam feeds its own IIMs. Plan which ones you are writing, early.
